mapper.sql: select p.plan_id, p.elderly_id, p.elderly_name, p.medication_name, p.dosage, p.usage_method, p.period_code, p.plan_time, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.reminder_enabled, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, ( select count(*) from biz_medication_record r where r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.execute_status = '1' ) as recent_taken_count, ( select count(*) from biz_medication_record r where r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.execute_status = '2' ) as recent_missed_count from biz_medication_plan p
